mood: Guinevere wakes in a street she never fell into, while Angela holds a bell of pink light against the dark.

hero.alt: Guinevere on her feet in a ruined street, blood at her lip and her pink hair blowing, one of her drones at her hand.

media.alt: On the scorched platform among the ruins, Vexana gets her staff under her and rises to one knee.
Four girls stand on a ruined waterfront below a vast four-pointed tear of violet light in the sky; then Fanny and Layla take aim side by side, blade and cannon ready.
